content: Ollama POST /api/generate accepts format as the string json or a JSON schema object, think as a top-level boolean/string/null (use /api/show for the model), and options.num_ctx. The response separates response text from an optional thinking field and reports prompt_eval_count and done_reason. done_reason is why generation stopped, not a truncation flag. Chat and embed paths can drop context silently; prompt_eval_count is the count of tokens actually evaluated.
